frame: desk: x right, y away from the writer, z up; z = 0 is the paper surface; writing area centred at x = y = 0

pen_magnet.label: Magnet ring in the pen's nose
pen_magnet.function: A small magnet near the tip that the board's electromagnet pulls on.

components.label: Board case
components.function: A flat case that sits on the desk under the paper.

components.label: Writing surface
components.function: A thin non-magnetic plate: the paper lies on it and the magnet moves just under it.

components.label: Rail (y)
components.function: Guide rail for the gantry bridge.

components.label: Rail (y)
components.function: Guide rail for the gantry bridge.

components.label: Gantry bridge (x)
components.function: Bridge that slides along the rails and carries the magnet carriage.

components.label: Carriage
components.function: Runs along the bridge, so the magnet can reach any point under the page.

components.label: Electromagnet
components.function: Pulls the magnet in the pen through the paper; its current sets how hard it pulls.

components.label: Motor (x)
components.function: Moves the carriage left and right.

components.label: Motor (y)
components.function: Moves the bridge toward and away from the writer.

components.label: Board electronics
components.function: Motor drivers, magnet driver and Bluetooth link to the pen and the app.
